claims.assertion: Mari presents her group’s view that pure consciousness exists beyond spacetime and manifests matter and energy through thought.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: In her proposed model, calm consciousness creates potential ether; thought produces ether waves whose consistent harmonics form persistent standing waves.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says collective consciousness slows manifestation, while focused individuals can influence it; outcomes reflect who people are, including unconscious patterns.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She attributes simple consciousness to objects and crystals, which can retain molecular frequencies; observers assign objects meaning through sensory input and memory.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

coverage_gaps: Choices, desires and information shaping personal development
